name: Comment spam purge
description: Measure the spam backlog, purge it reversibly (spam flag, never hard delete), then harden the comment settings so the backlog does not rebuild.

steps.title: Measure
steps.detail: Call wp_list_comments (status=spam, per_page=100) and wp_list_comments (status=hold, per_page=100): report counts and the oldest spam date.

steps.title: Purge the spam flag
steps.detail: With owner confirmation, call wp_moderate_comment (status=spam) for the confirmed-spam backlog. This keeps items recoverable.

steps.title: Review the pending queue
steps.detail: Read wp_list_comments (status=hold): separate real humans from pattern spam; propose the verdict per comment id but only act on explicit confirmation.

steps.title: Harden settings
steps.detail: Call wp_get_settings, then wp_update_settings to close registration for commenters and enable moderation queues, with owner confirmation.

steps.title: Report
steps.detail: Deliver before/after counts, settings changed, and the residual manual queue.

guardrails: Spam flag only, never permanent deletion, in this playbook.
Human-looking comments are never auto-flagged: they wait for the owner.
